strongest_reason: Willingness to pay is near zero (score 1/10), and developers already have free, entrenched open-source libraries (whatsapp-web.js, Baileys, Venom) that cover the core media-handling use case with workable workarounds, making a paid SaaS solution economically unviable.
strongest_risk: Platform risk is existential: any solution built on unofficial WhatsApp Web protocols can be broken by a WhatsApp update at any time, and if WhatsApp expands its official API capabilities, the need for this niche solution disappears entirely.
unresolved_assumption: The assumption that the reporter represents a broader set of developers with the same pain is unverified; only one source of evidence exists, and the low validation scores suggest the problem may be isolated rather than widespread.
recommended_next_step: If pursuing further, conduct a survey of at least 50 WhatsApp automation developers to validate pain intensity, frequency, and actual willingness to pay before any investment.
